Name: (CP or AT) Sticky for Dogs
Author: bobacup
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZqqhMHr8/sticky.png[/img][/center]
[color=#f4cccc][center]Sticky is a character from the 'Bee and PuppyCat' show created by Natasha Allegri!
This is fan art.

[b]Please do not edit / redistribute / claim these sprites as your own!
[/b]
The Content Patcher version for Stardew Valley 1.6 will add Sticky as an additional dog choice!
She comes in two variations![/center][/color]
[line]
[color=#e06666][size=6][b][u]୨୧  Installation & Use  ୨୧
[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#ea9999][u]For Content Patcher[/u][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b][b][color=#ea9999]To Install:[/color][/b][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]1.[/color][/b] Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for [b]1.6 [/b]is installed.
[b][color=#ea9999]2.[/color][/b] Download the Content Patcher version .zip from the Files tab on this mod page.
[b][color=#ea9999]3.[/color][/b] Extract the .zip and place the [CP] Sticky folder into your …\ Stardew Valley \ Mods folder

[b][color=#ea9999]Additional step:[/color][/b] You can choose between Sticky's original appearance or how she looks after eating part of Cardamon's
wish donut.
After launching Stardew Valley with SMAPI, a config.json file will generate within the [CP] Sticky folder. Change the option by editing the text inside after "Version":
"Classic" or "Donut" are the options. "Classic" is the default upon install.

Optionally, you can change the option at the in-game settings menu with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed.

[b][color=#ea9999]To Use:[/color][/b]
You can select Sticky as your starter pet on a new save OR purchase the pet license at Marnie's Ranch when the requirements are met.[/spoiler]

[b][color=#ea9999][u]For Alternative Textures[/u][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b][color=#ea9999]To Install:[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]1.[/color][/b] Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] is installed.
[b][color=#ea9999]2.[/color][/b] Download the Alternative Textures version .zip from the Files tab on this mod page.
[b][color=#ea9999]3.[/color][/b] Extract the .zip and place the [AT] Sticky folder into your …\ Stardew Valley \ Mods folder
[b][color=#ea9999]
To Use:[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]1.[/color][/b] Purchase the Scissors (a tool added by Alternative Textures) at Robin's Carpenter's Shop
[b][color=#ea9999]2.[/color][/b] Interact with the dog you'd like to change with the Scissors selected on your hotbar
[b][color=#ea9999]3.[/color][/b] Choose the Sticky option you'd like on the menu that appears[/spoiler]

[b][color=#ea9999][u]Known Issues[/u][/color][/b]
[spoiler]- Hats placed on Sticky will not be aligned correctly.
- Sticky's coloured limbs and bow-tie are not 100% consistent due to sprite limitations. [size=1]Hopefully not too obvious![/size]
- Alternative Textures has a bug with dog emote bubbles displaying twice[/spoiler]
